CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Exhaust }` (SecretWeapon.cs:13) == the inherited `_init_vars`'s `self.exhausts = True`. The sim models Secret Weapon as a SUBCLASS of SecretTechniqueCard overriding only `id`, `name` and `_WANTED_TYPE` (colorless_skills.py:698-708), which is legitimate: the two C# files are byte-identical apart from the type filter (`CardType.Attack` vs `CardType.Skill`), so every other verdict on card/secret_technique applies here by construction.

ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (SecretWeapon.cs:15-18) == the inherited cost 0 / SKILL / RARE / SELF. Note the card is a SKILL that fetches an ATTACK, and both sides carry that combination.

OnPlay.rationale: `filter: (CardModel c) => c.Type == CardType.Attack` (SecretWeapon.cs:22) == the overridden `_WANTED_TYPE`. Everything else -- the draw pile as the source, the single pick, the hand-size cap, the null-result skip -- is the shared implementation verdicted on card/secret_technique. BLAST RADIUS, not re-verdicted here per rule 3: `CardSelectCmd` auto-selects with no player choice and no RNG at or below MinSelect (CardSelectCmd.cs:287-290) where the sim's `select_cards` always delegates to the installed selector and otherwise falls back to `self._rng.sample` (sts2_rl/combat.py:1475) -- creature_card_cmds steps 104/105 and guard N10.
